title: Raspberry Pi 3 A+ / 1 A+
notes: 65 x 56 mm, holes 58 x 49 mm, 3.5 mm from the edges (official 3 A+ mechanical drawing, which the documentation says also applies to the 1 A+).
l = 0 is the microSD end, s = 0 the HDMI edge. The GPIO-header edge (s = S) faces the back plate, the ports face out.
The holes are symmetric along the long side, so one set fits either way round. The openings at both ends are the microSD notch (15 mm deep); the windows keep clear of the standoffs, as on PiB.
Parts from the official 3 A+ drawing: USB-A centred 31.5 mm from the HDMI edge (Z-Height 7.0), HDMI centred at 32 mm (Z-Height 6.5), GPIO header (Z-Height 8.5).
